openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.
Location lead as found (unverified): Mykolaiv (lead: osvita.ua gives the address as просп. Богоявленський, 43А, м. Миколаїв)

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead found. The vstup.osvita.ua institution page carries 2026 intake data (34 offers, licensed volume 238 places, 58 applications submitted) for the Mykolaiv address, and osvita.ua gives просп. Богоявленський, 43А, м. Миколаїв. Licensed volume appears to have grown from 166 places / 25 offers (2024 page) to 238 / 34 (2026 page). Mykolaiv is a front-adjacent city, but no search result reported a move, suspension or merger. Search-result leads only; the official site was not read.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No lead shows admission of foreign applicants, a licence to train foreigners, or English-medium teaching: a dedicated search for іноземних студентів / international students returned nothing for this institution (osvita.ua, vstup.osvita.ua, education.ua listings only). The institution appears to be out of scope for an international medical-admissions directory.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No medicine (222), dentistry (221) or pharmacy (226) programme lead: all leads show only nursing (I5/223) and public health (I9/229), despite the name 'university' and a 'медичний факультет' label.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion with its own attached vocational college: 'Фаховий коледж Медико-Природничого університету' / 'Фаховий коледж ПВНЗ «Медико-природничий університет»' is a separate listing (education.ua/colleges/1986/, vstup.osvita.ua/y2025/r15/6478/) offering фаховий молодший бакалавр nursing; do not merge college-level data into the university profile.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion with the listed Petro Mohyla Black Sea National University (also Mykolaiv): the English-language search returned PMBSNU's Wikipedia page; the two are distinct institutions (state vs private; different addresses).

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: English name is unsettled: 'Medical and Natural Sciences University' (education.ua) vs 'Medical-Natural University' (inventory literal translation); no official English form read.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Domain vnz-mpu.com.ua comes essentially from one publisher family (osvita.ua / vstup.osvita.ua), echoed by the college listing; not confirmed against the official site or the MON/EDEBO register.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Small private institution (licensed volume 166-238 places across all offers) with no government register entry visible in search results; accreditation status of its programmes is unknown.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Possible 2025-2026 specialty recoding (223 -> I5, 229 -> I9) means older listings and the current portal use different codes; they are the same specialties, not extra programmes.

Skeptic's note: Weakest programme lead in this batch: the only university-level offer concretely identified for 2026 is Public Health (I9/229, bachelor), which is not one of the four qualifying fields. The clearly identified nursing offer belongs to the attached vocational college (фаховий молодший бакалавр) and does not count.
